en.t: White 130 was like a thrust from a returning spear.

units.source_text: 大竹七段也说是“被回马枪击中了”。

en.t: Otake 7-dan also said that he had been struck by a returning spear.

units.source_text: 吴六段也解说道：“这里是微妙的地方，就是说，黑129断，白下130，包含了绝先的意思。”

en.t: Wu 6-dan also explained, "This is the delicate point. In other words, when Black cuts at 129 and White plays 130, it carries the idea of taking sente absolutely."

units.source_text: 对黑子的断，白子也并没有忽略，双方处在紧张的对峙局面，一方稍有松懈，就会被另一方当场击溃。

en.t: White had not overlooked Black's cut either. The two sides were locked in a tense standoff, and if either side relaxed even slightly, the other would crush it on the spot.
